scores.notes: Moses is the seated white-haired, white-bearded elder in a brown cloak on the left and the white-haired, white-bearded staff-bearer in brown cloak leading the crowd on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.
Watson is the stocky man with brown hair and a full brown moustache in the left armchair and the moustached man in a bowler with a doctor's bag on the right; face shape, moustache and build match.

On the right Peter is the grey-curly-haired, grey-bearded man lifting the beggar, but the left shows about eleven near-identical dark-haired bearded disciples around the fire and nothing singles out which one is Peter.

Both show the same kind of open wooden fishing boat with a lit lantern hanging from the mast on open grey-blue water under heavy cloud; the left is mid-storm in moonlight and the right calm with a paler twilight sky and a distant shore, which fits the storm-then-calm change asked for.

Moses is the white-haired, long-white-bearded elder with a staff walking ahead of the crowd on the left and the seated white-haired, white-bearded elder with arms held up on the right; hair, beard, age and dark cloak over pale robe agree.

Alice is a girl of the same age with long light golden-brown hair held by a dark band, fair skin and the same round face in both; hair is a little wavier on the right but colour, length and age agree.

Holmes on the left is a gaunt, older, hollow-cheeked man with a high receding hairline and hair slicked flat back; on the right he is a visibly younger, fuller-faced man with thick wavy dark hair falling over the forehead, so hairline and apparent age conflict.

Moses is the white-haired, full-white-bearded old man with a staff and brown cloak over a pale robe at the front of the crowd on the left and striking the rock on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

The left shows the white two-storey house ablaze at the end of a curving gravel drive with rose bushes; the right is a railway platform where only a distant smoke column over trees is visible and the house and grounds themselves are not shown, so the place cannot be compared.

Both show the same kind of dark open wooden boat with a bare central mast and rigging in a violent grey-green storm sea under black cloud; the right adds distant cliffs that the close, wave-filled left view would hide, which is compatible.

Jesus is a slim man with shoulder-length dark brown hair and a short dark beard, wearing a blue mantle over a pale tunic, standing in the boat on the left and before the tomb on the right; face, hair, beard and build agree.

Jesus on the central cross at left is small but shows long dark hair, a dark beard and a lean build, matching the long-dark-haired, short-bearded lean man standing in the boat at right; no cue conflicts.

Both show a circular pit of large grey dressed-stone blocks with a sandy floor and lions, lit by daylight from an opening above; the left is seen from inside and the right from the rim outside, a compatible change of viewpoint.

Daniel is the older man with short grey hair, trimmed grey beard and tan skin in a blue mantle over a white robe with a shoulder satchel, in the right foreground of the throne hall and among the lions; face, hair and beard match.

Both are night scenes under heavy dark cloud with teal-green walls of water flanking a wet, rocky seabed corridor and a hill town on the far shore; the left looks down the corridor from inside and the right from the near shore, which is compatible.

Peter is the stocky man with short curly dark hair and a full beard diving from the boat on the left and stepping on the water on the right; the right shows some grey in hair and beard under moonlight but hair style, beard, build and skin tone agree.

The left is grey overcast daylight at a brick station with the fire only a distant smoke column over flat fields, while the right shows the white house burning under a black night sky; day versus night conflicts and neither passage asks for that change.

Jesus on the central cross at left is small but shows shoulder-length dark hair, a dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe, matching the long-dark-haired, bearded man in the same blue mantle before the tomb at right; no cue conflicts.

Holmes is the gaunt, clean-shaven man with a hawk nose, high forehead and dark hair slicked back, seated right in the carriage and seated right with a pipe in the study; face shape, hairline and lean build match.

Moses is the old man with white hair and a full white beard, brown cloak over a pale robe and a crook staff, walking at the front on the left and raising the staff at the rock on the right; hair, beard and age agree.

Peter is the sturdy tan-skinned man with short curly grey hair and a grey beard, a net over his shoulder, stepping from the bow on the left and lifting the beggar on the right; hair, beard, age and build match.

Jesus is the man with shoulder-length dark hair and a dark beard in a blue mantle over a pale robe before the tomb on the left and, smaller, standing on the water on the right; hair, beard and build agree with no conflicting cue.
Holmes is the tall gaunt clean-shaven man with a widow's peak and dark slicked-back hair, standing centre on the left and seated with a pipe on the right; face shape, hairline and lean build match.

Moses is the white-haired, white-bearded old man with a crook staff and dark cloak standing beside the priest on the left and, in profile from behind, stretching the staff over the sea on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.
Watson is the solid man with side-parted brown hair and a thick brown moustache sitting on the bed on the left and in the armchair on the right; hair, moustache, face shape and build match.
Peter is the man with short curly dark hair and a short greying-dark beard walking on the water on the left and standing by the fire with hand on chest on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Moses is the old man with long white hair and a full white beard, brown cloak over a pale robe and a tall staff, standing beside the priest on the left and leading the crowd at right front on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Jesus is the slim man with shoulder-length dark brown hair and a short dark beard in a blue-grey mantle over a pale robe, standing in the boat on the left and, smaller, on the water at far right; hair, beard and build agree.

Moses is the seated old man with swept-back white hair and a full white beard in a brown cloak on the left and the white-haired, white-bearded man in a brown cloak striking the rock on the right; hair, beard and age match.

Daniel is the lean older man with cropped grey hair, a trimmed grey beard and tan skin in a blue fringed mantle over a pale robe with a satchel, among the lions on the left and at the right edge before the fiery throne; face, hair and beard match.

Holmes is the tall gaunt clean-shaven man with hollow cheeks and a sharp nose, stooping with a cane under a bowler on the left and bare-headed with slicked-back dark hair on the right; the hat hides the hairline on the left but face, age and build agree.

The left shows the white house ablaze with fire engines and rose bushes at night; the right is a night-time station platform where only a distant fiery glow and smoke behind trees is visible, with none of the house or grounds shown to compare.

Alice is a young girl with long straight light golden-brown hair and fair skin seated at the table on the left and standing mid-court on the right; on the right she is smaller and partly turned away, but hair colour and length, age and build agree.
David is the slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and tan skin kneeling to be anointed on the left and slinging the stone on the right; hair, age, build and beardless face match.

Moses is the old man with windblown white hair and a long white beard, brown cloak and crook staff, seen in profile on the rock at left and facing forward beside the priest at right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

On the right Peter is the large foreground man with curly dark hair and a greying beard, but the left shows about eleven small, near-identical dark-haired bearded disciples round the fire and nothing reliably singles out which is Peter.

Both show a daytime sandy shore and seabed corridor between curling teal-green wave walls under grey storm cloud with pale sandy land beyond; the left is from the near shore as the sea opens and the right looks along the opened path, which is compatible.

Jesus on the central cross at left is small but shows long dark hair, a dark beard and a lean build, matching the long-dark-haired, dark-bearded man pointing at the tomb on the right; no cue conflicts.

Moses is the old man with white hair and a full white beard, dark-brown cloak over a pale robe and a crook staff, walking ahead of the crowd on the left and standing beside the priest on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.
Daniel is the lean older man with short grey hair and a grey beard in a dark-blue mantle over a pale robe with a waist pouch, standing in the pit in both images; hair, beard, age and build match.

David is the slim, clean-shaven, fair-tan youth with short dark curly hair in a rough brown tunic, slinging on the left and kneeling at the brook on the right; the left is smaller but hair, age and build agree.

Alice is a young fair-skinned girl with long straight golden-brown hair, holding the flamingo on the left and sitting in the armchair on the right; hair colour and length, age and build agree despite the different expression.

Moses is the old man with swept-back white hair and a full white beard, brown cloak over a pale robe and a crook staff, striking the rock on the left and standing by the priest on the right; hair, beard, age and build match.

Both show a white two-storey house with a central porch ablaze and fire engines in front, but the left is a dark night scene with bare leafless trees and a straight muddy lane, while the right is daylight under grey cloud with leafy green trees and a curving drive lined with rose bushes; time of day and vegetation conflict.

Watson is the sturdy man with brown hair and a thick brown moustache, in a bowler on the left carriage seat and bare-headed sitting in the dark bedroom on the right; moustache, face shape, age and build agree.

Jesus is the slim man with shoulder-length dark brown hair and a short dark beard in a dark-blue mantle over a pale robe, pointing at the tomb on the left and standing in the boat on the right; face, hair, beard and build match.

Daniel is the older tan-skinned man with short grey hair and a grey beard in a blue fringed mantle over a pale robe with a scroll pouch, climbing the rope in the pit on the left and addressing the king on the right; the left is small but hair, beard and age agree.

Watson is the man with a reddish-brown moustache and ruddy face, in a bowler and brown suit with a doctor's bag on the left and bare-headed with auburn-brown hair on the right carriage seat; he looks a little stouter and rounder-faced on the small left figure, but moustache, colouring and age agree.

Both show a long white-clothed tea table on a lawn in front of a huge tree trunk at centre-right with a multi-gabled timbered house with chimneys set back at the left; the house is browner on the left and more clearly half-timbered on the right, but the layout matches.

Jesus on the cross at left has long dark hair, a short dark beard and a lean build, matching the long-dark-haired, dark-bearded lean man in a blue mantle standing on the water at right; hair, beard and build agree.

David is the slim clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair in a rough brown tunic with a shoulder bag, kneeling under the oil on the left and holding the sling at right; hair, age, skin tone and build match.

Jesus is small in both but shows shoulder-length dark hair, a dark beard and a blue mantle over a pale robe, standing on the water on the left and on the central cross on the right; the visible hair, beard and build agree with no conflict.

Peter in the courtyard on the left is a middle-aged man with short dark hair and a dark beard; the man diving from the boat on the right has grey-white hair and a grey beard and looks clearly older, so hair colour and age conflict.

Peter is the man with short curly dark hair and a greying beard, hand on chest at the far left of the courtyard and bending to lift the beggar on the right; the left figure is smaller but hair, beard, age and build agree.

Both have a clothed tea table on grass under a big tree, but the house behind differs: on the left a plain low tan clapboard cottage with a shingle roof and simple side porch close by, on the right a tall ornate grey Victorian house with decorative gable trim, an arched upper window and a centred porch with steps; Alice's seat also changes from a tan wing chair to a brown round-backed chair.
Both show the same brick barrel-vaulted cellar with arched bays, a stone-flagged floor and stacked wooden crates lit by a single lantern; brickwork, arches, floor and crates are arranged compatibly.

Moses is the old man with swept-back white hair and a full white beard in a brown cloak over a pale robe, standing with a crook staff beside the priest on the left and seated with arms held up on the right; hair, beard, age and build match.

Peter is the sturdy man with short curly dark-grey hair and a greying beard with a net over his shoulder, large in the left foreground of the courtyard and standing forward with a staff by the fire on the right; hair, beard, age and build agree.

Alice is a young fair-skinned girl with long straight golden-brown hair, standing before the caterpillar on the left and seated in the wing chair on the right; hair colour and length, age and build agree.
